methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 8 same-sector + similar-valuation-tier peers in AI & Software. Range: $3.2B - $39.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in AI & Compute

data.narrative:
Applied Intuition, a Series F AI & Software company, is evaluated against a peer universe of eight private companies in the same sector and valuation tier, plus one public comparable (Palantir, PLTR). The peer set spans valuations from $3.25B to $39.0B, with notable private comparables including Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Scale AI ($29.0B), and Reflection AI ($25.0B).

Peer-median valuation analysis is the applicable triangulation method here. The median across the eight-company peer set is $12.0B, providing an empirically grounded reference point. Stage-progression methodology was excluded due to data integrity concerns: the reported $15.0B last post-money valuation exceeds 20x the company's $600M+ total raised, suggesting a funding-tracker parse error that would yield an implausible $19.5B step-up valuation.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $10.2B to $13.8B, centered on the peer median of $12.0B. This implies a modest 15% discount to the stated $15.0B valuation. Key uncertainties include the reliability of peer valuations in a volatile frontier-tech sector and the absence of public market comparables specific to Applied Intuition's autonomous vehicle simulation focus. The wide dispersion in the peer set ($3.2B to $39.0B) reflects sector-wide valuation volatility and warrants caution in precision claims.
